purpose: Machine-readable route-family evidence map for the HotM Fortemi v2026.7.1 verifier planning path. This is SDLC planning evidence; implementation PRs should keep it aligned with the generated route inventory.

evidence_levels.strong: Current source and focused test evidence exist for the route family.
evidence_levels.medium: Source evidence exists with adjacent tests or broad route coverage, but route-level parity still needs verifier hardening.
evidence_levels.weak: Source or planning evidence exists, but focused route-level test evidence is missing or unclear.
evidence_levels.none: No HotM implementation evidence was found, or the family is intentionally excluded.

archives.verifier_action: Assert archive and memory route parity, including stats, clone, set-default, and memory overview paths.

attachments.verifier_action: Assert list, note attachments, upload, download, subtitle, thumbnail, VTT, sprite, and delete route coverage.

attachments_tus.verifier_action: Preserve TUS coverage for POST creation metadata, media_optimize create-query handling, OPTIONS discovery, HEAD resume headers, PATCH required headers/offset, DELETE termination, GET finalization, termination aborts, upload-store degraded states for offset mismatch/chunk-too-large/expired-not-found recovery, and the explicit no checksum-extension claim.

audio_tools.verifier_action: Preserve `/audio/transcribe` multipart client tests plus attachment preview transcription success, unsupported media, endpoint error, transcript rendering, and no raw model-name rendering assertions.

auth_api_keys.verifier_action: Add or confirm API key list/create/delete tests with copy-once and redaction assertions.

backup_archive.verifier_action: Preserve API route-shape and BackupManager UX evidence for legacy backup, knowledge shard import/upload, database download/snapshot/upload/restore, memory download, knowledge archive download/upload, list/detail/swap, metadata get/update, and portable shard limitation copy.

chat_sync.verifier_action: Preserve synchronous chat and model-list fallback while native stream work lands.

collections.verifier_action: Add exact route-level assertions for collection CRUD, collection notes, note move, and collection export.

concepts.verifier_action: Assert scheme, concept, relationship, governance, Turtle export, collection, and note-concept route coverage.

contract_docs.verifier_action: Preserve advertised OpenAPI/AsyncAPI link rendering, root-relative contract fetch tests, and source-route extraction verifier coverage.

document_types.verifier_action: Add or confirm API-level tests for list, create, get, patch, delete, and detect routes.

embeddings.verifier_action: Assert embedding set/config CRUD, members, refresh, default config, and fallback path behavior.

graph.verifier_action: Preserve route-level tests for diagnostics, snapshots, history, compare, SNN, PFNET, community, maintenance, cold-spots, topology, and graph fetch.

health.verifier_action: Preserve basic health/live checks; do not use this family to satisfy streaming health.

inbound_sources.verifier_action: Preserve metadata-only list/create/delete coverage and redaction assertions for names, kinds, URLs, headers, credentials, and connector config.

incoming_webhook_receivers.verifier_action: Preserve incoming receiver list/create/get/update/delete/validate API coverage, Admin metadata rendering, and no raw slug/provider/schema/HMAC secret assertions.

inference.verifier_action: Add route-level assertions for config, audit, providers, complete, stream, and test-connection with redaction.

jobs.verifier_action: Assert list, detail, stats, status, pause/resume, archive pause/resume, pending, and extraction stats.

knowledge_health.verifier_action: Assert all knowledge-health endpoints in fixtures: knowledge, orphan tags, stale notes, unlinked notes, tag cooccurrence, access frequency.

models.verifier_action: Preserve `/api/v1/models` catalog and `/api/v1/chat/models` agent-selection route assertions.

native_chat_stream.verifier_action: Preserve native Fortemi POST stream parser, Last-Event-ID support, delta/done/error handling, Agent hook streaming, cancellation path, and synchronous fallback on stream failure.

notes.verifier_action: Assert every note route family member, including bulk, restore, purge, reprocess, tags, links, backlinks, related, export, full, provenance, versions, diff, timeline, activity, status, concepts, and move.

oauth.verifier_action: Preserve OAuth discovery, authorize URL/consent/form, register, token, introspect, revoke route tests plus Admin diagnostics redaction assertions. Hosted session/role UX remains gated until Fortemi advertises that contract.

outbound_webhooks.verifier_action: Preserve outbound lifecycle tests and keep incoming receivers as separate gap work.

pke.manual_evidence: No current HotM PKE UX claim.
pke.verifier_action: Ensure UI and agent prompts do not claim PKE support until a product slice opens.

provenance.verifier_action: Preserve route-level tests for note provenance plus provenance location, named-location, device, file, and note creation endpoints; memory provenance stays covered by memory APIs.

rate_limit.manual_evidence: No general HotM rate-limit status UX claim; manifest launch proof is tracked separately.
rate_limit.verifier_action: Keep excluded unless manifest/rate-limit diagnostics become an explicit product surface.

realtime_calls.manual_evidence: `GET /api/v1/calls/{id}` is available as redacted Admin API Surface call diagnostics; `GET /api/v1/realtime/twilio/{provider_call_id}` remains a documented exclusion with no helper or product claim.
realtime_calls.verifier_action: Preserve typed `/calls/{id}` REST client tests, redacted call diagnostics UI tests, transcript/provider-ID non-rendering assertions, and Twilio realtime no-claim copy.

realtime_events.verifier_action: Assert SSE event parsing, WebSocket fallback, resync/degraded states, and activity drawer integration.

search.verifier_action: Assert `/search` and `/search/federated` plus agent search tool route usage.

streaming_health.verifier_action: Preserve `/health/streaming` parser and UI tests for populated, missing, malformed, unavailable, chat drop counters, ingest pressure, connector lag/errors, and call telemetry summaries.

streaming_ingest.verifier_action: Preserve ingest token mint/revoke, NDJSON POST stream upload, ack/progress/warning/error/done/cursor parsing, progress UI, and token revocation/no-secret-render tests.

system_compatibility.verifier_action: Keep fail-closed unknown/preview/unavailable compatibility fixtures current.

tags.verifier_action: Assert tag list and manager behavior.

templates.verifier_action: Add API-level route assertions for template CRUD and instantiate.

vision_tools.verifier_action: Preserve `/vision/describe` multipart client tests plus attachment preview image-analysis success, unsupported media, endpoint error, and no raw model-name rendering assertions.
